statusDetail: Origin content was not auditable: Cloudflare returned a managed human-verification challenge to both Chrome and direct HTTP requests. No score or origin-site findings are published.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare challenge markup was observable; the application architecture and templates remain unknown.

Mobile viewport showing the same Cloudflare verification wall.
Rendered DOM and styles belong to the Cloudflare challenge, not the origin site.

Security headers observed on the challenge response; these cannot be attributed to the protected origin.
Raw fetch returned HTTP 403 and browser/crawler captures both received the challenge.
Crawler view of the challenge response.
Direct HTTP response headers showing status 403 and cf-mitigated: challenge.
Raw Cloudflare challenge HTML returned instead of origin content.
Materialised 58-check coverage manifest with catalog version and planned evidence hints.
Modern Web Guidance guide IDs retrieved from the pinned catalog before judgement.
